title: Design: Active and Inactive tabs after deactivating every term
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has switched off every term it can and uses Net 30 as the default, and you compare both tabs with the design.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Every term that can be deactivated is deactivated, and Net 30 is the default.
  • The browser window is 1440 px wide, at 100% zoom.
    For example: a maximised window on a 1440 x 900 screen.
  • The design pictures ct-p4-01-active-tab-after-deactivating-everything-it-can.png, ct-p4-02-inactive-tab-the-rest.png are attached to this case; open each at 100% zoom beside the screen.
  • Starting screen: the Settings page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the Settings menu, click "Credit Terms".
  2. Click the "Inactive" tab.
  3. Resize the browser window to 1536 px wide (for example, maximise it on a 1536 x 864 screen at 100% zoom).
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the Active tab lists only COD, Due on Receipt, Net 30 (with the "Default" pill) and Credit Hold, in that order (as in ct-p4-01-active-tab-after-deactivating-everything-it-can.png).
  • Step 2: the Inactive tab lists every other term in the same order as the Active tab uses, in the same columns with the same widths (the headings do not move), with no info icon, lock icon or Default pill (as in ct-p4-02-inactive-tab-the-rest.png).
  • Step 3: at 1536 px nothing overlaps, nothing is cut off and nothing needs a sideways scroll; the layout described above is unchanged, only wider.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-E1: “If every term that can be deactivated has been deactivated, the Active tab lists COD, Due on Receipt, Credit Hold and, when the default is another term, the default (it can't be deactivated, S2-N4). The Inactive tab lists everything else.”
  • S1-R4: “Each tab shows one table with the columns Name, Due, Customers, Vendors, and an unlabeled actions column holding the row's "⋯" menu (Story 2: Row menu actions). The columns keep the same widths on both tabs.”
  • S1-R14: “The Active tab lists every active term; the Inactive tab lists every deactivated term, standard and the shop's own, in the same columns and order.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Default Credit Terms" (https://claude.ai/artifact/2erYxWz2ffDNcoXzEfu6wf), read 23 Oct 2026: page "4 Everything deactivated and an empty tab" ("Active tab after deactivating everything it can", "Inactive tab: the rest"). Compare the screen with the pictures below; the expected results above come from the PRD quotes, except where this held design case follows the design.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ct-p4-01-active-tab-after-deactivating-everything-it-can.png
  • ct-p4-02-inactive-tab-the-rest.png

The design's own words:

  • “What stays: COD, Due on Receipt and Credit Hold (always available) and Net 30 (the default, so it can't be deactivated). Every other term, the shop's own included, can be deactivated (S1-E1).”
  • “Every deactivated term, in the same order. Customers still on them keep them (Net 15 has 12).”
